newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bildt spokesman denies report he to quit.
newsitem.headline: Bildt spokesman denies report he to quit.

text.p: A spokesman for Bosnian peace coordinator Carl Bildt denied a report on Tuesday that the former Swedish premier was about to announce he was leaving the job.

The Swedish TT news agency said Bildt would announce his resignation at an international meeting on Bosnia which starts in London on Wednesday. The agency said Bildt wanted former Norwegian Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland to take over.
"This is the purest fantasy," said Michael Maclay, a spokesman for Bildt. The Bosnian mediator was in Lisbon for a European security summit.
Bildt, leader of the main opposition party in Sweden, has said he expects to return to domestic politics next year but has so far not said when he will go.
